main_body: Steampunk factory building: a large corrugated metal roof slab (rows ~28-90) above a brick wall with arched windows, central riveted double door and copper pipes (rows ~92-126), plus a brick chimney.
top_band: Roof reads as a big sloped surface of grey-blue corrugated metal, rows ~28-90, with a lighter ridge band at rows 28-31 and a skylight strip at rows 31-35; the roof is the top surface, with the wall front face below it.
evidence: Column through the middle: dark ridge cap at row 28, light ridge band, a skylight strip, then roughly 55 rows of corrugated roof slope with shading steps and dormer windows. An orange eave line at rows 90-92 marks the front edge. Under it, a darker row begins the brick wall, about 34 rows of front face with inset arched windows and a recessed riveted door. The roof is a large visible sloped surface and the wall is a distinct south face, so this is a proper 3/4 building. The roof is flat-looking in its outline, but it clearly shows a top slope above the wall.

style.evidence: The roof has several grey-blue steps with vertical corrugation lines, a darker lower band, rust speck dots and skylight panes. The brick wall has varied browns and mortar, and the windows have glowing amber panes with multiple tones. The outlines lean dark blue-grey or brown next to each material, not pure black. Texture is a bit more regular than Beodeul's per-tile clumps, and the roof has large corrugated areas with only subtle variation, so density is slightly under the reference. It is still comparable in craft and not sticker-like.
